# Kontoor Brands Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings and Conference Call Date


[Download as PDF](https://www.kontoorbrands.com/_assets/_3b1f534ffd893de46229467dabc988e1/kontoorbrands/news/2026-11-02_Kontoor_Brands_Announces_Third_Quarter_2026_246.pdf) November 02, 2026 6:50am EST


GREENSBORO, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) today announced plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, November 5, 2026, at approximately 6:50 a.m. ET.


Following the news release, Kontoor management will host a conference call at approximately 8:30 a.m. ET to review results.


The conference call will be broadcast live and accessible at kontoorbrands.com/investors. For those unable to listen to the live broadcast, an archived version will be available at the same location.


***About Kontoor Brands***


Kontoor Brands, Inc. (NYSE: KTB) is a global apparel company with deep authority in the denim, outdoor and workwear categories. *Wrangler* ® and *Helly Hansen* ® are iconic brands that empower consumers to pursue their passions with confidence and authenticity through innovative design, exceptional products and compelling performance. Kontoor's global platform, scale and operational expertise drive sustainable brand growth and deliver long-term value for its stakeholders. For more information, please visit[www.KontoorBrands.com](http://www.kontoorbrands.com/) .
